title: Telemetry load failure renders as 'No telemetry data yet'
body:
## Summary
useGenreEvolution swallows both GET failures, so a failed stats/history load paints the empty-state invitation instead of an error.

## Description
src/hooks/useGenreEvolution.ts:39 `.catch(() => null)` and :40 `.catch(() => [])` turn an HTTP/DB failure into the same value as 'no scans'. TelemetryEvolution (src/components/modules/core-engine/TelemetryEvolution/index.tsx) then shows EmptyState 'No telemetry data yet / Run First Scan'. The scan path already distinguishes failure (scanError banner); the load path does not. Fixed: the hook returns a loadError and the panel shows an inline error + Retry instead of the empty state. Out of this round's paths (src/hooks/).

## Flow
- GET /api/telemetry?action=stats returns 500
- fetchGenreData catches -> stats null
- panel renders EmptyState as if never scanned

## Expected impact
Anyone whose telemetry read fails sees an invitation to scan instead of the failure; measured by a hook test with a rejecting fetch. Could break: the reduced-motion test mocks the hook and would need the new field.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a failed load is stated, not shown as empty
Before: fetch rejects -> panel shows 'No telemetry data yet' (read at useGenreEvolution.ts:39-40, 1 walked case)
After: fetch rejects -> role=alert load error with Retry, no EmptyState
Method: simulation - the hook is outside this round's paths, so the probe was not built here
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/hooks/useGenreEvolution.ts:39
src/hooks/useGenreEvolution.ts:40
src/components/modules/core-engine/TelemetryEvolution/index.tsx:120 (EmptyState when all lists empty)
instrument: vitest: renderHook(useGenreEvolution) with fetch stubbed to 500 -> assert a loadError; render TelemetryEvolution with it -> assert role=alert and no 'No telemetry data yet'

title: Resolve controls disagree on when they are disabled (4 sites)
body:
## Summary
Four resolve entry points apply three different disabled rules during a batch fix or a running scan.

## Description
Header 'Resolve all' (src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/index.tsx:76) and 'Mark Selected Resolved' (:211) disable on isBatchFixing only; the row 'Mark Resolved' (src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/FindingRow.tsx:166) is never disabled, even for the row being fixed; ScanDelta 'Resolve N no longer found' (src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/ScanDelta.tsx:391) disables only on its own busy flag. None disable while a scan runs, though the running scan was dispatched with the active findings as previousFindings. Fixed: one canResolve rule from useScanTab used by all four.

## Flow
- start a batch fix of f1,f2
- expand f1 (the active fix) and click Mark Resolved -> allowed
- header Resolve all -> disabled

## Expected impact
One consistent rule; which rule is right (block during a scan or not) needs the reconcile behaviour checked. Could break: a flow that resolves during a long scan.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one resolve-enable rule
Before: 4 sites, 3 distinct rules (read)
After: 1 rule, 4 sites
Method: simulation - the correct rule depends on server reconcile semantics during a running scan, not measured
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: render ScanTab with isBatchFixing / scanCli.isRunning true and count enabled resolve controls; plus a route test resolving a finding between scan dispatch and import to see what the delta reports

title: Suggestion Accept/Dismiss has no pending guard
body:
## Summary
Accept and Dismiss can be clicked repeatedly or in sequence while the first POST is in flight; the last write wins.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/TelemetryEvolution/SuggestionsList.tsx:306 and :318 fire onResolve with no pending state; src/lib/telemetry-db.ts:181 resolveSuggestion is a blind UPDATE, so Accept then a quick Dismiss leaves 'dismissed' after the UI showed acceptance. Fixed: a per-suggestion pending id in TelemetryEvolution, both buttons disabled until the refresh lands.

## Flow
- expand a suggestion
- click Accept then Dismiss before the refresh
- both POSTs sent; final status = dismissed

## Expected impact
Prevents accidental double resolution of an install-wide change to module checklists. Could break: nothing beyond disabled buttons.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - one resolution per click sequence
Before: 2 POSTs for Accept+Dismiss within one refresh (walked)
After: 1 POST; the second click is ignored while pending
Method: simulation - not probed this round; budget went to measured items
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/TelemetryEvolution/SuggestionsList.tsx:306
src/components/modules/core-engine/TelemetryEvolution/SuggestionsList.tsx:318
src/lib/telemetry-db.ts:181-187 (UPDATE ... WHERE id = ?, no status guard)
instrument: vitest: render TelemetryEvolution with a never-resolving resolveSuggestion, click Accept then Dismiss -> expect resolveSuggestion called once

title: resolveSuggestion reports success for an unknown suggestion id
body:
## Summary
The telemetry resolve route returns success even when no suggestion row matched.

## Description
src/lib/telemetry-db.ts:181 runs UPDATE without checking `.changes`; src/app/api/telemetry/route.ts:125 then returns success. A stale panel (suggestion resolved elsewhere) gets a silent no-op. Fixed: return the change count and apiError 404 when it is 0. Owned by the database-layer / API context, not this round's paths.

## Flow
- POST {action:'resolve', suggestionId:'nope', resolveAction:'accept'}
- UPDATE matches 0 rows
- response success: true

## Expected impact
The panel's new Accept-failure alert (e512b3ed) would then cover this case too. Could break: a caller relying on success for a missing id.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a no-op resolve is reported
Before: unknown id -> success (read)
After: unknown id -> 404 'suggestion not found'
Method: simulation - out-of-scope route/db files
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest route test: POST resolve with an unknown id against a temp DB -> assert success:false

title: GenreDnaTimeline keeps its own formatPatternName copy
body:
## Summary
GenreDnaTimeline re-implements the pattern-name formatter TelemetryEvolution/helpers.ts exports, with a weaker body.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/GenreDnaTimeline.tsx:42 `w[0].toUpperCase()` throws on an empty segment (e.g. 'a--b'); src/components/modules/core-engine/TelemetryEvolution/helpers.ts:4 uses charAt(0) and is safe. Two implementations of one rule, one hardened. Fixed: GenreDnaTimeline imports the helper. Outside this round's paths.

## Flow
- a pattern id with a double dash reaches the timeline
- w[0] is undefined
- render throws

## Expected impact
Removes one copy and one crash shape. Could break: nothing; same output for well-formed ids.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one formatter
Before: 2 implementations, 1 throws on empty segments (read)
After: 1 implementation
Method: simulation - file out of this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: GenreDnaTimeline's formatPatternName('a--b') throws; after importing the helper it returns 'A  B'

title: Resolved findings cannot be reopened individually
body:
## Summary
Once resolved, a finding comes back only through the one-shot Undo of the last resolve; the Resolved section is read-only.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/ResolvedSection.tsx renders resolved rows as struck-through text with no action; the PATCH already supports resolved:false (src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/useScanTab.ts setResolved). A mistaken resolve older than the last action cannot be undone from the UI. Fixed would be a per-row Reopen. A new capability, so it is the operator's call.

## Flow
- resolve f1, then resolve f2
- Undo now only covers f2
- f1 has no reopen control

## Expected impact
Lets users correct mis-resolutions; adds a control to a dense panel.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - mis-resolutions are recoverable
Before: 0 per-row reopen controls
After: 1 per resolved row
Method: simulation - a product decision, no figure decides it
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
instrument: operator decision; then a vitest clicking Reopen -> PATCH resolved:false

title: genre_suggestions has no project column
body:
## Summary
Genre suggestions and acceptances are stored install-wide; scoping them to a project needs a schema migration.

## Description
src/lib/telemetry-db.ts:127-131 states the table has no project column and the reads are deliberately global; this round made the UI say so for suggestions (d15ca312). The real fix (project-scoped suggestions) is a migration over stored rows that have no project to backfill, so it is irreversible for legacy rows.

## Flow
- scan project A -> suggestion stored
- open project B -> the same suggestion is listed and acceptable

## Expected impact
Project B stops seeing A's suggestions; legacy rows need a policy (drop, keep global, or attribute).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - suggestions follow the project
Before: global read for every project
After: project-scoped read
Method: simulation - schema change out of scope
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: irreversible
instrument: operator chooses the legacy-row policy; then a migration test over a DB copy
